data.title: Git-fetch-file – Sync files from other repos with commit tracking and safety
data.author: andrewmcwatters
data.article_summary: `git-fetch-file` 是一个可以从其他 Git 仓库中获取和同步单个文件或文件集的工具，具有提交跟踪和本地更改保护功能。它类似于一个简化的子模块，但仅针对你想要的文件。主要功能包括：从远程仓库拉取单个文件或文件集，通过 `.git-remote-files` 文件记录来源和提交信息，支持强制覆盖本地更改和更新跟踪的提交。它提供简单的命令行接口，可以通过 Git 别名或直接保存到 PATH 进行安装。主要命令包括 `add`（跟踪文件）、`pull`（下载跟踪文件）和 `status`（查看跟踪文件状态）。该工具采用 GPL-2.0 许可证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[如何高效地从不同代码库中提取并跟踪文件]

不同观点：
• [支持使用新工具git-remote-files]  
  - 用户andrewmcwatters提出git-remote-files工具，可以单独跟踪并更新其他仓库的特定文件，避免使用笨重的submodules或拉取过多文件。  
  - 用户ttoinou认为该工具优于git submodules，因为后者只能跟踪commit ID，不够灵活。  
  - 用户dpsych表示这正是他需要的解决方案。  

• [考虑替代方案]  
  - 用户neomantra提到使用CI脚本校验文件checksum的方案，认为这是一种轻量级的通用解决方法，避免了submodules的复杂性。  

• [实际问题驱动讨论]  
  - 用户Bukhmanizer提出从不同仓库拼接复杂软件的艺术项目设想，引发对文件提取工具的讨论。  
  - 用户neomantra和andrewmcwatters均提到实际开发中需要从上游仓库提取文件的场景，但依赖管理或submodules无法满足需求。  

补充讨论：  
- 争议焦点在于如何平衡灵活性与可靠性：submodules虽稳定但笨重，新工具更灵活但可能引入信任问题（如neomantra对二进制文件来源的担忧）。  
- andrewmcwatters后续补充了分支跟踪和.gitignore集成功能，进一步优化方案。

git-fetch-file
Fetch and sync individual files or globs from other Git repositories, with commit tracking and local-change protection
git-fetch-file(1)
is a utility for importing specific files from other Git repositories into your own project while keeping a manifest (.git-remote-files) that remembers where they came from and what commit they belong to.
It’s like a mini submodule, but for just the files you want.
Features
Pull a single file or glob from a remote Git repo
Track origin, commit, and comments in .git-remote-files
Optionally overwrite local changes with
--force
Update tracked commits with
--save
Simple CLI interface
Installation
Option 1: Git Alias (Recommended)
Save the script anywhere and set up a Git alias:
git config --global alias.fetch-file
'
!python3 /path/to/git-fetch-file.py
'
Then run it like this:
git fetch-file
<
subcommand
>
[args...]
Option 2: PATH Installation
Save the script as
git-fetch-file
somewhere on your PATH.
Commands
add
Track a file (or glob) from a remote Git repository.
git fetch-file add
<
repo
>
<
path
>
[target_dir] [--commit
<
commit
>
] [--glob] [--no-glob] [--comment
<
text
>
]
repo: The URL or path to the remote Git repo
path: Path (or glob if --glob is used) to the file(s) in the remote repo
target_dir: Optional target directory to place the file (preserves filename)
--commit: Optional commit, branch, or tag to track (default: HEAD)
--glob: If specified, interprets path as a glob pattern
--no-glob: If specified, treats path as literal filename (overrides auto-detection)
--comment: Add a descriptive comment to the manifest
pull
Download all tracked files.
git fetch-file pull [--force] [--save]
--force: Overwrite local changes to files
--save: Update the commit in .git-remote-files if you're tracking a branch or tag that moved
status
View all tracked files.
git fetch-file status
git fetch-file list
#
alias for status
.git-remote-files
Each tracked file is recorded in .git-remote-files (INI format). Example entry:
[file "lib/util.py"]
repo
= https://github.com/example/tools
commit
= a1b2c3d
target
= vendor
comment
= Common utility function
This file should be committed to your repository.
Example
Track a remote file
git fetch-file add https://github.com/user/project utils/logger.py --commit main --comment
"
Logging helper
"
Track a file into a specific directory
git fetch-file add https://github.com/user/project utils/logger.py vendor --commit main --comment
"
Third-party logging helper
"
Pull it into your repo
git fetch-file pull

文章讨论了构建计费系统的复杂性，尽管表面上看起来只是定期向客户收费。作者解释了不同计费模式的挑战，如订阅制（包括基础、进阶、高级套餐）、按席位收费模式，以及近年来兴起的按使用量计费模式。每种模式都带来了独特的技术难题，如处理试用期、中途升级或降级、实时使用跟踪、高吞吐量事件处理、以及灵活适应不断变化的定价模型等。

Why Building Billing Systems is So Painful
@dalexeenko

#
What is billing
Billing might seem like a straightforward concept at first glance. When I talk about billing to friends, most of them bring up their monthly subscriptions, whether it's Netflix, Spotify, ChatGPT or something similar. How hard can it be to engineer a system to support this? After all, all you need to do is to charge a customer a fixed amount each month. You can probably set up a cron job to do that. Done. However, as any seasoned engineer will tell you, the billing space is a deceptively complex beast that becomes exponentially more intricate as your product scales. Let's talk about that complexity.
So what is billing exactly? First, let's talk about subscriptions. It's a revenue management model where businesses charge recurring payments for access to products or services. A common example is the good-better-best pricing model used by many SaaS startups. Customers choose a tier (good, better, or best) and pay a flat rate for it. Typically each tier has both monthly and yearly prices. For example, Netflix offers the following 3 tiers: (1) Basic: $7.99/month, (2) Standard: $10.99/month, and (3) Premium: $13.99/month. At Stripe we put together the following diagram to
demonstrate the good-better-best approach
:
Another popular pricing model example is per-seat pricing. In this case the user picks how many seats they plan to use, and the business then charges them based on that amount (another diagram from Stripe):
Sounds easy. However, each of these models comes with its own set of challenges. From managing trial periods that need to be billed at a reduced amount or offered for free, to handling upgrades and downgrades that can happen in the middle of the billing cycle, which then prompts the additional complexity of prorated charges or credits. From managing fixed contract periods with financial penalties for early cancellation, to supporting multiple currencies once you want to sell your product globally. From allowing customers to bundle several products together at a discounted rate, to managing entitlements to grant or revoke features based on the customer's active subscription plan.
In recent years, another pricing model found itself in the limelight — usage-based billing (I blame AI). You pay exactly for the resources you consume. That could be hours of CPU usage, number of function invocations at the edge, GB of egress for storage, number of tokens generated, etc. This all sounds great, yet, all of this introduces another layer of technical challenges:
Real-time usage tracking. Real-time is the keyword here. In order to provide customers with visibility into resource consumption the billing system needs to work in real time. As your customers approach certain usage and cost thresholds, you may need to notify them, before they receive an unexpected $100,000 invoice. This typically means relying on a stateless event-based architecture, to both provide a real-time balance and scalable webhooks platform.
Handling high ingestion volume (think hundreds of thousands of events per second). The whole billing system needs to be designed to handle extremely high throughput and scale with concurrent load.
Adapting to changing pricing models. E.g., if an application developer defines a billable event as "GB used" and then decides to change it to "GB used per region", you shouldn't require the application developer to reimplement their pricing model and integration.
Allowing for flexibility in the data model. If you change packaging, pricing, or decide to add a new product, it's important not to force application developers reimplement the entire integration: they shouldn't need to create new billable metrics, make changes to integration around subscriptions, products, prices, customers, or backfill all of their previous subscriptions.
These are just a few examples. The folks over at Lago have more stories about
why billing is 100x harder than you think
. If that's not enough to convince you,
read this
.
#
Why billing matters
Billing isn't just about sending an invoice to your customer. It's the lifeblood of your business. Full stop. Simply put, if you can't charge for your product, then there isn't really any economic value from it. Billing ultimately dictates how your business makes money. Typically billing isn't just invoicing, instead it spans an entire revenue management workflow: from contract and quote management, to provisioning, from product and price management, to usage metering, from managing entitlements, to invoice generation and delivery, from payment processing, to revenue recognition. data.title: Debian 13 Trixie Review: 11 Features That Make It the Biggest Release in Years
data.author: teleforce
data.article_summary: Debian 13 "Trixie" marks a significant transformation in the Debian project, featuring major upgrades and new features. It includes GNOME 48 and KDE Plasma 6.3, offering improved UX, performance, and HDR support. The release introduces a new visual theme called "Sereratopsian" and updates over 42,000 packages, adding 11,000 new ones while removing 9,000 obsolete ones. It runs on the Linux Kernel 6.12 LTS, enhancing hardware support and real-time performance. Other notable changes include TMPFS mounted by default for /tmp, early RISC-V support, and a fix for the Y2K38 bug. Enhanced security measures, such as protection against ROP attacks and ARM64 vulnerabilities, are also included, ensuring robust stability and future-proofing the system.

Debian has long been the cornerstone of the Linux ecosystem. From Ubuntu to Raspberry Pi OS, many popular distros are based on Debian. Now, in 2025, the arrival of Debian 13 “Trixie” marks one of the most substantial leaps in the projectâs history. With cutting-edge upgrades to GNOME and KDE, TMPFS optimizations, RISC-V support, and deep security enhancements, this release is not just incrementalâitâs transformative.
Letâs walk through the 11 key features that make Debian 13 truly exceptional.

1. GNOME 48: A Massive Upgrade in UX and Performance
Debian 13 ships with
GNOME 48
by defaultâa significant leap from GNOME 43 in Debian 12. That’s five major versions ahead!
What does this bring?
Notification stacking
: Grouped alerts from the same app make your workspace cleaner.
Digital well-being
: Track screen time and set usage limits.
HDR mode support
: For displays that support it, expect richer colors and deeper contrast.
Dynamic triple buffering
: Dramatically improves animation fluidity on mid and low-end systems.
Overall, GNOME 48 feels more polished, faster, and modernâa major win for Debian users.
2. KDE Plasma 6.3: A New Era for Plasma Users
If GNOME got a facelift, KDE got reconstructive surgery. Debian 12 shipped with Plasma 5.27. Debian 13?
Plasma 6.3
.
Hereâs whatâs changed:
Built-in tiling
: Press
Meta + T
to open the tiling manager.
Floating panels
and
Qt6-powered visuals
Transparent widgets
for that glassy, modern effect
Explicit GPU sync
: Greatly reduces screen tearing on Nvidia hardware
HDR enhancements
and
tone mapping
This generational jump makes KDE on Debian feel like an entirely new experienceâone that is sleek, smart, and production-ready.
3. Trixie Theme and Aesthetic Updates
Every Debian release gets its name from a Toy Story character. Debian 13 is named
Trixie
, the blue triceratops.
A new visual theme called
Sereratopsian
now graces the bootloader, login screen, and wallpapers.
Designed by
Alice Cooper
, selected via public poll
GTK and application themes remain minimal, in classic Debian fashion
This isnât a flashy update, but it adds personality to Debian without compromising its stability-first philosophy.
4. Massive Package Updates
Debian 13 updates
over 42,000 packages
and adds
11,000+ new ones
, raising the total count to
59,000+
.
LibreOffice 25
Python 3.13
GCC 14.2
Rust 1.85
9,000 obsolete packages removed for improved quality
You wonât get the latest bleeding-edge packages like Arch or Fedora, but Debian ensures one thing:
bulletproof stability
.
5. Kernel 6.12 LTS: Performance and Hardware Support
Debian 13 now runs on
Linux Kernel 6.12 LTS
, up from 6.1 in Debian 12. This brings key improvements:
Real-Time Preempt (RT) patch
: Improves latency and real-time performance, even useful for industrial or robotics use.
EEDF scheduler
: Boosts responsiveness, especially during CPU-intensive tasks like gaming or compiling.
Intel Panther Lake & Diamond Rapids CPU support
Improved support for new GPUs (Intel Xe2)
If youâre using new hardware, Debian 13 just works betterâand faster.
6. TMPFS Enabled by Default
Hereâs a quiet but powerful change: Debian 13 mounts
/tmp
as
tmpfs
by default.
What does this mean?
Temporary files now live in
RAM
, not on disk
Faster app installations and updates
Reduced wear on SSDs
Default tmpfs uses
up to 50%
of RAM (but only on-demand)
You can customize it using
systemctl edit tmp.mount
or disable it entirely if you prefer traditional
/tmp
behavior. For most users, especially with 8GB+ RAM, this brings a big speed bump.
7. RISC-V Support (Early but Important)
Debian 13 officially supports
RISC-V
architecture.
Why this matters:
RISC-V is open hardware: no licensing fees, fully customizable
Great for educational tools, experimental devices, and the open hardware movement
Currently limited to
sifive HiFive boards
and basic emulation, the RISC-V journey is just beginning. But Debianâs involvement means weâre heading toward a more open hardware future.
8. Y2K38 Bug Fixed
The
Year 2038 bug
(similar to Y2K but for Unix timestamps) could have broken systems storing time beyond Jan 2038.
Debian 13 migrates entirely to
64-bit
time_t
, eliminating this bug for all architectures except i386.

: Protects against Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) attacks

data.title: Mac history echoes in current Mac operating systems
data.author: classichasclass
data.article_summary: Ars Technica报道，在macOS Tahoe中，旧的硬盘图标将被更通用但较单调的新图标取代。用户可以从特定系统文件中提取旧图标保存。此外，Apple Symbols中仍保留许多过时的图标，如PowerPC标志、SCSI、ADB端口、Newton设备图标等，这些图标大多没有Unicode编码，无法复制。类似的情况也存在于系统的资源文件中，包含多种旧设备如iBook G4、iMac G4、PowerBook G4等不同尺寸的图标。这些遗留图标可能因商标和法律原因保留在macOS中，而非出于怀旧目的，因为Apple通常不支持过时的应用程序。

44819962.article_content:
Ars Technica mentioned
that in
macOS Tahoe
the venerable old hard disk icons will be replaced with new, more generic, relatively less interesting equivalents. This process also apparently happens with Apple CEOs from time to time. If you are on Sequoia and want to keep them for posterity, you can get them out of
/System/Library/Extensions/IOStorageFamily.kext/Contents/Resources
. I'm still impressed to this day that someone not only took the time to write actually plausible text copy for the label, but also gave it Torx screws. Get out your T8 MacCracker for this drive:
This isn't the only echo of Macs past in the operating system.
The Spacebar
also noticed that Apple Symbols still has many old, nay, "obsolete" icons that are only of use to people who still use web browsers on Power Macs.
That's not the half of it, though. There's a bunch more in that file than the ones he spotted. Here's what I saw; perhaps you can find more.
In order: PowerPC logo, composite video out and in, S-video out and in (such as seen on some later PowerBooks), modem port, combined modem/printer port (like on the Duo 2300), printer port, SCSI, Ethernet (also AAUI), three glyphs for Apple Desktop Bus (ADB) ports, a server, rainbow outline Apple, Balloon Help (from System 7), Apple Guide (7.5), 5.25" floppy (I guess mostly for the Apple II folks), two Newton lightbulbs, Newton undo, Newton extras, Newton dates, Newton names, high-density 3.5" disk icon, a confused Compact Mac (possibly to evoke the flashing question mark when it can't find a bootable volume), classic QuickTime logo, busy watch, Apple Pro Speakers port (such as on the iMac G4 or the MDD G4), FireWire, programmer's key icon, and two versions of the reset icon, though these three do have Unicode equivalents or you can also use regular geometric shapes, and sometimes those faced the other way.
(A note on most of these characters is that they don't actually map to any defined Unicode code point; they are unconnected glyphs. Font Book will show them but you can't really copy them anywhere. A tool like Ultra Character Map will let you at least grab a graphical representation and paste it somewhere, as I have done here.)
But that's not all! Feast your eyes on what's still in
/System/Library/CoreServices/CoreTypes.bundle/Contents/Resources
!
What's particularly impressive is the
multiple sizes
for systems with differently sized screens as options. These are taken from the 1024x1024 144dpi retina versions in Sequoia.
eMac,
iBook G4 12" and 14",
iMac G4 15" (my favourite because it doesn't wear out the arm), 17" and 20",
iMac G5 (recognizeable because no iSight) 17" and 20",
iPhone 2G and 3G (notice the subtly different chrome),
Titanium PowerBook G4,
Alumin(i)um PowerBook G4 12", 15" and 17" (with all-region DVD drive firmware it's the best portable DVD player you can get),
"Graphite" Power Macintosh G4 (doesn't say if it's a Yikes!, Sawtooth or Gigabit Ethernet),
"Quicksilver" Power Macintosh G4,
"Mirrored Drive Doors" Power Macintosh G4, which looks nearly the same,
Xserve G4,
early Mac mini (we'll call it a G4, since we can't see the back),
and who let this thing in?
Why are all these things still in the macOS? My guess, modulo the Blue Screen PC, is trademark purposes. These all were used as Apple-specific labeling and could be considered as part of their trade dress, and having these legacy items still in the macOS probably serves some legal purpose if someone were to try to rip off their old IP. It can't be for nostalgia purposes or we'd still be able to run Carbon PowerPC apps on Tahoe like you can still run most Win32 applications on Windows 11. And Apple just doesn't
do
nostalgia — except in their ads.

data.title: More than two hard disks in DOS
data.author: userbinator
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了Microsoft OS/2 1.21磁盘驱动程序的异常行为，并追溯到Compaq的EXTDISK.SYS驱动程序。研究发现，DOS 5.0之前的版本不支持系统BIOS暴露的两个以上硬盘，若硬盘过多，系统启动时可能挂起。这种限制源于技术问题而非架构设计，因为早期PC无法安装超过两个全高5¼英寸硬盘。Compaq通过其Deskpro 386/25系统支持最多四个硬盘，但通过EXTDISK.SYS驱动解决DOS的限制。Adaptec的AHA-1540/1542 SCSI卡也面临类似问题，通过ASPI4DOS.SYS和ASPIDISK.SYS解决。DOS 5.0之前的版本在处理超过两个硬盘时会出现挂起问题，因其未验证INT 13h返回的硬盘数，导致系统在计算文件系统参数时陷入无限循环。此问题在DOS 2.0到4.0版本中普遍存在，直到DOS 5.0才修复。

44779494.article_content:
Investigating the rather odd behavior of the
Microsoft OS/2 1.21 disk driver
led me to
Compaq and their EXTDISK.SYS driver
. While experimenting with various setups, I realized that DOS versions older than 5.0 do not support more than two hard disks exposed by the system’s BIOS, and will in fact quite likely hang early during boot-up if there are “too many” hard disks.
This seems to have been one of the many things that “everyone knew” back in the day, similar to the fact that DOS versions older than 3.3 may
hang while booting
from disks with significantly more than 17 sectors per track.
As was the case with the “too many sectors per track” problem, the issue with “too many hard disks” was missed for years simply because no one had a PC with more than two hard disks. This was a technical rather than architectural limitation. While the IBM PC/XT and PC/AT BIOS implementations were limited to two hard disks, the INT 13h interface as such was not.
In the days of full-height 5¼” drives, it simply was not feasible to install more than two hard disks into a PC, especially when a 5¼” floppy drive was also required. Even the big IBM PS/2 Model 80 (1987) with a tower case could only house two full-height 5¼” drives. There might also be trouble with the power supply, as the PC hard disks of the time were not designed for staggered spin-up and a standard AT power supply might have trouble spinning up four drives at the same time.
Sure, there were half-height hard disks, but who wanted four drives in the first place? People who needed to maximize the storage capacity… and the most obvious way to do that was buying a large capacity drive, which in the 1980s was inevitably a full-height 5¼” monster. Like my
1988-model 650 MB ESDI drive
, for example.
Yes, there were solutions like the NetWare DCB which supported many drives, but those were only usable by NetWare and did not expose the drives via INT 13h.
Two things happened circa 1988. One was Compaq releasing the Deskpro 386/25 with an expansion unit option, a system which supported up to four hard AT-style disks (that is, the expansion unit housed up to two ESDI drives accessible via the PC/AT hard disk style programming interface, which may be called WD1003 or WD1010 or several other things). The other development was Adaptec releasing the AHA-1540/1542 SCSI HBA, and there were perhaps other SCSI vendors as well.
Compaq supported up to four hard disks, Adaptec in theory up to seven. In any case, it is apparent that both companies ran into the same problem with DOS, and solved it in a very similar manner.
Compaq simply did not expose the drives in the expansion unit through the BIOS at all. DOS users needed the EXTDISK.SYS driver, and users of other operating systems (such as OS/2 or NetWare) needed a custom driver.
Adaptec was in a more complicated situation. The AHA-154x was an add-on card which could be installed in a PC/AT compatible machine (the AHA-154x did not work in older systems because it was a bus-mastering adapter) that already had one or two AT style drives. The AHA-154x BIOS keeps the total hard disk maximum to two. In practice that means that if there are two SCSI hard disks attached to an AHA-154x (which also includes AHA-154xA and AHA-154xB, but not necessarily newer models), the Adaptec BIOS may add zero, one, or two drives to the system, depending on how many hard disks there are already installed. In any case, the total won’t be greater than two.
For DOS users, Adaptec offered a combination of ASPI4DOS.SYS (ASPI driver for the AHA-154x) plus ASPIDISK.SYS (DOS hard disk device driver). Adaptec’s ASPIDISK.SYS was functionally very similar to Compaq’s EXTDISK.SYS and allowed DOS users (especially users of DOS 4.x and older) to utilize more than two hard disks.
DOS Bug
The bug is quite visible in the MS-DOS 4.0 source code. In MSINIT.ASM (IO.SYS/IBMBIO.COM module), DOS
calls INT 13h/08h
and stores the number of disks in the HNUM variable. No attempt is made to validate the value returned by INT 13h.
Further down in MSINIT.ASM, DOS
sets up the hard disks
, calling the SETHARD routine for each drive, but it will not set up more than two. Trouble will start near the
SETIT label
, where the DRVMAX variable may end up with a number much higher than the number of drives that SETHARD was run on.
Eventually, disaster strikes in the $SETDPB routine in the DOS kernel. The
code near LOG2LOOP label
attempts to calculate the cluster shift for the FAT file system, but gets stuck in an endless loop because the BPB for a drive was never initialized and contains zeros.
This bug is present in every DOS version with hard disk support before 5.0, that is, in DOS 2.0 up to and including DOS 4. In my experiments, all these DOS versions hang when booting on a machine that exposes four BIOS drives. MS-DOS 4.01 from April 1989 still hangs, and so does Russian MS-DOS 4.01 from February 1990.
It is clear that the bug went unnoticed or at least unfixed for a number of years simpl

data.title: A candidate giant planet imaged in the habitable zone of α  Cen A
data.author: pinewurst
data.article_summary: 这篇文章报告了使用詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜上的MIRI仪器对距离太阳最近的恒星之一——半人马座α星A的日冕观测结果。在2024年8月、2025年2月和2025年4月的三次观测中，研究团队发现了可能的巨行星候选者S1，其距离恒星1.5角秒，有效温度约为225-250 K，半径约为1-1.1木星半径，质量在90-150地球质量之间。S1在2024年8月的观测中被检测到，但在2025年的两次观测中未被发现。结合之前的VLT/NEAR观测数据，S1可能与2019年观测到的C1是同一物体，轨道周期为2-3年，偏心率约为0.4，且与半人马座α星AB轨道平面有较大倾角。这些发现为进一步研究该行星候选者的性质和轨道提供了基础。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕半人马座Alpha A系统中潜在巨行星及其可能拥有宜居卫星的讨论

不同观点：
• [TMEHpodcast] 认为，虽然该行星可能是气态巨行星，人类无法直接居住，但其可能拥有的卫星，尤其是如果存在类似地球大小且富含水的卫星，可能提供宜居条件。这使该系统成为寻找可居住世界的最近目标。然而，考虑到目前如David Kipping提出的TARS推进系统（以约40 km/s速度发射微型探测器），到达该星系仍需30,000年以上。因此，当前最好的策略是继续观察，期待未来开发出如核聚变推进的技术。

• [Qem] 提供了对该行星候选者的具体数据分析，指出其温度可能为225K，半径约为1-1.1倍木星半径，质量在90-150倍地球质量之间，这些数据与RV限制一致。同时表达了对该行星可能拥有有趣卫星的期望。

• [axblount] 计算了该行星表面的重力加速度，基于其质量（120倍地球质量）和半径（木星半径），得出的重力加速度为9.7 m/s²，认为这一数值相对适宜。

• [azalemeth] 指出，尽管比邻星（Proxima Centauri）是距离我们最近的恒星，距离为4.25光年，但半人马座Alpha A作为最接近太阳的类太阳恒星，距离也不过4.34光年，差距不大。同时，对未来使用离子推进器的探测器访问该星系表示期待。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了多种推进技术，如TARS推进系统和离子推进器，显示出对未来太空探测器访问该星系的期待与技术挑战的关注。
• 讨论还涉及了该行星候选者的物理特性，如温度、半径和质量，这些数据为推测其宜居性和潜在卫星条件提供了基础。
• 争议的焦点可能在于当前技术限制与未来技术发展的预期，尤其是在探测和访问该星系的实际可行性上。

Abstract:
We report on coronagraphic observations of the nearest solar-type star, $\alpha$ Cen A, using the MIRI instrument on the James Webb Space Telescope. With three epochs of observation (August 2024, February 2025, and April 2025), we achieve a sensitivity sufficient to detect $T_{\rm eff}\approx$ 225-250 K (1-1.2 $R_{\rm Jup}$) planets between 1"-2" and exozodiacal dust emission at the level of $>$5-8$\times$ the brightness of our own zodiacal cloud. The lack of exozodiacal dust emission sets an unprecedented limit of a few times the brightness of our own zodiacal cloud$-$a factor of $\gtrsim$10 more sensitive than measured toward any other stellar system to date. In August 2024, we detected a F$_\nu$(15.5 $\mu$m) = 3.5 mJy point source, called $S1$, at a separation of 1.5" from $\alpha$ Cen A. Because the August 2024 epoch had only one successful observation at a single roll angle, it is not possible to unambiguously confirm $S1$ as a bona fide planet. Our analysis confirms that $S1$ is neither a background nor a foreground object. $S1$ is not recovered in the February and April 2025 epochs. However, if $S1$ is the counterpart of the object, $C1$, seen by the VLT/NEAR program in 2019, we find that there is a 52% chance that the $S1+C1$ candidate was missed in both follow-up JWST/MIRI observations due to orbital motion. Incorporating constraints from the non-detections, we obtain families of dynamically stable orbits for $S1+C1$ with periods between 2-3 years. These suggest that the planet candidate is on an eccentric ($e \approx 0.4$) orbit significantly inclined with respect to $\alpha$ Cen AB orbital plane ($i_{\rm mutual} \approx 50^\circ$, or $\approx 130^\circ$). Based on the photometry and orbital properties, the planet candidate could have a temperature of 225 K, a radius of $\approx$1-1.1 $R_{\rm Jup}$ and a mass between 90-150 $M_{\rm Earth}$, consistent with RV limits.

44819738.article_summary: 这篇文章报告了使用詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜上的MIRI仪器对距离太阳最近的恒星之一——半人马座α星A的日冕观测结果。在2024年8月、2025年2月和2025年4月的三次观测中，研究团队发现了可能的巨行星候选者S1，其距离恒星1.5角秒，有效温度约为225-250 K，半径约为1-1.1木星半径，质量在90-150地球质量之间。S1在2024年8月的观测中被检测到，但在2025年的两次观测中未被发现。结合之前的VLT/NEAR观测数据，S1可能与2019年观测到的C1是同一物体，轨道周期为2-3年，偏心率约为0.4，且与半人马座α星AB轨道平面有较大倾角。这些发现为进一步研究该行星候选者的性质和轨道提供了基础。
44819738.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕半人马座Alpha A系统中潜在巨行星及其可能拥有宜居卫星的讨论

不同观点：
• [TMEHpodcast] 认为，虽然该行星可能是气态巨行星，人类无法直接居住，但其可能拥有的卫星，尤其是如果存在类似地球大小且富含水的卫星，可能提供宜居条件。这使该系统成为寻找可居住世界的最近目标。然而，考虑到目前如David Kipping提出的TARS推进系统（以约40 km/s速度发射微型探测器），到达该星系仍需30,000年以上。因此，当前最好的策略是继续观察，期待未来开发出如核聚变推进的技术。

• [Qem] 提供了对该行星候选者的具体数据分析，指出其温度可能为225K，半径约为1-1.1倍木星半径，质量在90-150倍地球质量之间，这些数据与RV限制一致。同时表达了对该行星可能拥有有趣卫星的期望。

• [axblount] 计算了该行星表面的重力加速度，基于其质量（120倍地球质量）和半径（木星半径），得出的重力加速度为9.7 m/s²，认为这一数值相对适宜。

• [azalemeth] 指出，尽管比邻星（Proxima Centauri）是距离我们最近的恒星，距离为4.25光年，但半人马座Alpha A作为最接近太阳的类太阳恒星，距离也不过4.34光年，差距不大。同时，对未来使用离子推进器的探测器访问该星系表示期待。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了多种推进技术，如TARS推进系统和离子推进器，显示出对未来太空探测器访问该星系的期待与技术挑战的关注。
• 讨论还涉及了该行星候选者的物理特性，如温度、半径和质量，这些数据为推测其宜居性和潜在卫星条件提供了基础。
• 争议的焦点可能在于当前技术限制与未来技术发展的预期，尤其是在探测和访问该星系的实际可行性上。

data.title: Running GPT-OSS-120B at 500 tokens per second on Nvidia GPUs
data.author: philipkiely
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何在NVIDIA GPU上优化GPT OSS 120B模型，以在发布当天实现最先进的延迟和吞吐量。团队通过实验、修复错误和基准测试，成功在OpenRouter上实现了领先的性能。主要步骤包括：首先运行基准推理，利用TensorRT-LLM等框架进行测试；修复兼容性问题，确保模型在Hopper和Blackwell架构上的运行；选择张量并行策略以优化延迟，并采用TensorRT-LLM MoE后端提升性能。团队不断进行性能调优，实现了每秒500+ tokens的吞吐量，并在发布日提供了卓越的用户体验。优化过程依赖于灵活的推理堆栈和团队的丰富经验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：GPT开源模型（OSS）在不同硬件和环境下的性能、配置问题及其实际应用的可行性。

不同观点：
• blitzar认为高端GPU（如H100）价格昂贵且不易获取，暗示了一般用户难以使用这些高端硬件。
• wcallahan分享了在MacBook Pro上运行GPT-OSS-120B的实际体验，指出模型在处理大窗口和总 tokens 时的性能下降问题，以及LLM在无网络环境下的功能受限情况。
• mikewarot关注模型中数组维度信息的难以获取，强调在静态类型语言中这些信息更容易得到，并探讨了在理想计算条件下通过网络传输输出token的最大速度问题。
• mutkach对TensorRT-LLM的设置难度和维护成本提出批评，认为虽然其性能优越，但在多种模式下配置困难，且需要与生产环境完全一致的硬件和软件栈。

补充讨论：
• zackangelo提到Blackwell芯片对fp4的支持，并分享了自己在Rust中添加fp4和fp8支持的工作，旨在支持Mixlayer中的模型。
• sarthaksoni认为相比之下，GPT-OSS 20B在Mac上的设置非常简单快捷，感谢Lama的易用性。
• tmshapland对模型需要大量调优才能表现良好表示惊讶，原来以为模型开箱即用。
• adsharma询问vLLM和SGlang在H100上的最佳表现，并对MLPerf更新速度缓慢表示不满。
• lagrange77寻找一个能清晰显示不同OS LLM模型在特定GPU上运行的网站，并分享了一个估算VRAM需求的启发式方法。
• eric-burel对OpenAI的OSS模型在保护自由言论和美国价值观方面的作用表示关注，并提到硬件问题是开发者面临的一个主要限制。
• radarsat1询问在消费级硬件上进行本地agentic编码的可行性，特别是对于VRAM较小的笔记本电脑。
• nektro分享了不同硬件平台在真实世界中的性能数据，认为NVIDIA GPUs的表现虽然不错，但仍有提升空间。
• magicalhippo对推测解码的功能表示不解，质疑在没有验证草案token的情况下如何提升模型推断速度。
• smcleod同意TensorRT-LLM设置和维护的困难，认为虽然有人能成功配置，但不适合所有人。

争议焦点：
• TensorRT-LLM的设置复杂性和维护成本是否值得其性能优势。
• 高端GPU（如H100）在实际应用中的获取难度和性价比问题。
• 推测解码的实际效用和其在模型推断中的作用。

44819968.article_content:
Model performance
How we run GPT OSS 120B at 500+ tokens per second on NVIDIA GPUs
How we optimized GPT OSS 120B for state-of-the-art latency and throughput on launch day.
Authors
Amir Haghighat
Tri Dao
Abu Qader
Bryce Dubayah
Philip Kiely
Last updated
August 7, 2025
Share
TL;DR
Day zero model performance optimization work is a mix of experimentation, bug fixing, and benchmarking guided by intuition and experience. This writeup outlines the process we followed to achieve SOTA latency and throughput for GPT OSS 120B on NVIDIA GPUs at launch with the Baseten Inference Stack.
The day an open source model like OpenAI’s new gpt-oss-120b is released, we race to make the model as performant as possible for our customers. As a
launch partner
for OpenAI’s first open-source LLM since 2019, we wanted to give developers a great experience with the new LLMs.
By the end of launch day, we were the clear leader running on NVIDIA GPUs for both latency and throughput per public data from real-world use on
OpenRouter
.
✕
What matters is having the inference optimization muscle to immediately push on latency and throughput
Optimizing performance on a new model is a substantial engineering challenge. Thanks to our flexible
inference stack
and the collective expertise of our model performance engineering team, we are able to roll out performance improvements by the hour on new models.
In fact, in the time it took to write this blog post, we added another 100 tokens per second while maintaining 100% uptime.
✕
OpenRouter performance for GPT OSS, 6:45 PM August 6, 2025
Model performance efforts included:
Testing and benchmarking across inference frameworks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang)
Ensuring compatibility with Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures
Integrating with key pieces of our inference stack, including NVIDIA Dynamo
Layering in our favorite performance optimizations, like KV cache-aware routing and speculative decoding with Eagle
Below are the steps we took to achieve our goal of SOTA performance with full context window support.
Step 1: Running first inference
The first step is running baseline inference however possible. Running inference on a model requires support at the inference framework, hardware architecture, and model server level.
Inspired by GPUs, we parallelized this effort across multiple engineers. One engineer tried vLLM, another SGLang, and a third worked on TensorRT-LLM. We were able to quickly get TensorRT-LLM working, which was fortunate as it is usually the most performant inference framework for LLMs.
✕
NVIDIA cut a dev release of TensorRT-LLM to support GPT OSS
With TensorRT-LLM, it was important to serve the model on both Hopper and Blackwell architectures to support widely-available H100 GPUs and access the speed of B200 GPUs for our public model APIs.
One key tenet of the Baseten Inference Runtime is flexibility. This is especially useful when serving new models with novel architectures. Navigating, and when necessary updating, the support matrix across the entire stack requires the ability to swap between tools quickly.
Step 2: Fixing compatibility bugs
Whenever a new model architecture is released, there will be subtle bugs and issues when integrating it into existing frameworks. The GPT OSS release added multiple new technologies, including
Harmony
, a new response format.
✕
Romain Huet of OpenAI warns that implementation details affect performance and output quality.
A large part of our engineering work was iteratively fixing bugs and testing models for both speed and correctness. Where we could, we
contributed back to open source
with the fixes that worked for us.
Thanks to the hard work of open source maintainers worldwide, there are multiple excellent options for running GPT OSS, and bugs are getting identified and fixed quickly.
Step 3: Optimizing model configuration
While OpenAI advertises that GPT OSS 120B can be run on a single H100 GPU, optimized deployments parallelize the model across 4 or 8 GPUs for improved performance and throughput. There are two parallelism approaches worth considering for this model: Tensor Parallelism and Expert Parallelism.
✕
Tensor Parallelism vs Expert Parallelism for mixture of experts models
We found that Tensor Parallelism offered better latency, while Expert Parallelism offered better system throughput. As we are prioritizing latency, we selected Tensor Parallelism.
Additionally, we adopted the TensorRT-LLM MoE Backend, which is supported on Blackwell but not Hopper. This backend adds improved CUDA kernels that outperform the previous Triton backend. For more details on server configuration, see
NVIDIA’s TensorRT-LLM documentation for GPT OSS optimization
.
We packaged our preferred configuration for Hopper GPUs for the
120B
and
20B
models for dedicated deployments in our model library, and used Blackwell for our Model API.
✕
GPT OSS 120B Model API on Baseten, optimized for performance with full context window support
Next steps in performance optim

data.title: Coursera’s Preview Mode
data.author: deepakkarki
data.article_summary: Coursera正在限制免费课程的访问，仅允许用户访问某些课程的第一模块，其余内容将被付费墙锁定。这一变化是在新CEO Greg Hart领导下进行的，其目的可能是为了增加营收和提升公司股票表现。在Hart的领导下，Coursera的股票价格上涨了36%，公司估值超过20亿美元。尽管Coursera财务状况良好，拥有大量现金储备，但新推出的“预览模式”似乎主要是为了迎合投资者需求，而非出于可持续性考虑。这一转变标志着Coursera从长期以来保持的免费访问模式发生了重大变化，可能会影响全球学习者访问教育资源的方式。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MOOCs（大规模开放在线课程）的实际影响和局限性

不同观点：
• MOOCs具有实际价值，但受限于学历至上的招聘环境：
  - __rito__ 认为MOOCs有改变生活的潜力，并提供了实际技能，但招聘时公司更看重学历，这限制了MOOCs的全面影响力。他举例说明自己通过MOOCs学到的技能在面试中发挥了作用，但最终还是依靠硕士学位获得面试机会。
  - 他还提到在一些前沿AI实验室中，博士学位已成为最低要求。

• MOOCs仅对少数有自学动力的学习者有价值：
  - robertritz 指出MOOCs仅对约3%有自学动机的学习者有价值，对其他人基本无用，且常被用作LinkedIn上的炫耀工具。技术达到一定水平后，MOOCs的帮助有限。

• MOOCs在某些地区和平台上依然蓬勃发展：
  - nileshtrivedi 提到印度的NPTEL项目非常成功，拥有大量订阅者和课程注册人数，且通过低成本的监考考试提供认证，这表明MOOCs在某些地区仍有巨大影响。

• MOOCs在特定领域和改进功能上仍有价值：
  - Grokify 表示从Coursera和AWS Skill Builder等平台获得了实质性价值，特别是AI审查和互动角色扮演课程等新功能。

• MOOCs在数据科学等领域具有提升技能的作用：
  - rgavuliak 不同意MOOCs未实现变革潜力的说法，认为在数据科学等领域，MOOCs帮助许多人提升了技能。

• MOOCs对招聘和职业机会的实际帮助有限：
  - klipklop 认为MOOCs对职业机会帮助不大，不如YouTube视频或社区大学课程。

补充讨论：
• MOOCs与传统教育在信号传递和证书价值上的对比：

44778125.article_content:
Coursera now limits free access to only the first module of certain courses, like this University of Michigan Python course.
Last week, Coursera’s new CEO, Greg Hart, delivered something the company’s investors had been eagerly awaiting: growth.
In his
first full quarter as CEO
, Greg’s leadership helped drive Coursera’s stock price up 36% following the earnings call, pushing the company’s valuation past the $2 billion mark.
However, this pursuit of prioritizing Wall Street could come at a cost to learners worldwide. The company is rolling out a “Preview Mode,” a feature that would lock almost all course content, including video lectures.
Coursera’s Monetization Journey: A Quick Recap
Coursera’s original 2012 homepage declared a mission to make “the best education in the world freely available to any person who seeks it.”
Coursera formally launched in January 2012 with the mission statement: “We are committed to making the best education in the world freely available to any person who seeks it.” At that time, Coursera had no business model.
Over the years, Coursera gradually introduced monetization features, including certificates, specializations, and subscription plans, while placing certificates and graded assignments behind paywalls. This transition is detailed in my article,
Coursera’s Monetization Journey: From Zero to IPO
.
During the
Jeff Maggioncalda era
(June 2017 to early 2025), Coursera maintained a relatively stable free auditing policy. Under his leadership, learners retained access to video content for most courses, even as certificates and graded assignments required payment.
While competitors like edX and FutureLearn
implemented time-based paywalls
,
restricting all course content
, Coursera largely resisted this approach, keeping video lectures accessible to non-paying users.
That appears to be changing under new leadership.
Coursera’s New “Preview” Mode
Preview mode restricts full course access and adds a paywall, allowing users to sample only the beginning of the course.
In early July, while attempting to enroll in
Programming Languages I
from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, I encountered a significant change: the course was completely locked, with only Module 1 accessible.
When I consulted with my
Classmates
(that’s what we call each other at Class Central), they reported full access to the same course, minus the graded assignments. This inconsistency suggested that Preview Mode was in limited testing.
I reached out to my network familiar with this matter and confirmed that Preview Mode is real and will be deployed across the platform.
What remains unclear is the extent of this deployment. What percentage of courses will be affected? Will universities have the option to opt out? Will it be limited to certain geographic regions?
Class Central will be closely monitoring these developments.
Courses that have offered free video access for years, some for over a decade, may soon become restricted. This represents a fundamental shift from a model that had been stable for years.
I dread to think of all the places and different articles we published on Class Central that need to be updated.
When $17 Million Turns into Half a Billion Dollars
Coursera’s revenue continues to grow steadily in Q2, 2025.
After failing to boost the stock price
through layoffs
and stock buybacks, Coursera
replaced its long-time CEO
with Amazon veteran Greg Hart.
In Hart’s first full quarter as CEO, he raised Coursera’s 2025 revenue outlook by $17 million, projecting a range of $738 million to $746 million. During the earnings call, CFO Ken Hahn attributed the current quarter’s growth to “strong receptivity to our Coursera Plus subscription offerings and marketing campaigns, including localized promotions and pricing that benefited our paid conversion rate.”
This likely translates to increased discounting (a recent Coursera trend) and geographic pricing adjustments that reduce costs in countries with lower purchasing power.
While this represents only a 2% increase in annual revenue, Wall Street responded dramatically: Coursera’s stock price surged 36%. In other words, a modest 2% revenue boost made Coursera’s investors and employees half a billion dollars richer overnight.
Hart indicated the additional $17 million will come from the consumer business, which he described as having “a more responsive model.” This suggests Coursera can adjust pricing strategies more aggressively to maximize revenue, and the upcoming Preview Mode rollout is part of this approach.
Previously when MOOC providers implemented paywalls, it was done in the guise of sustainability. Yet Coursera’s financials tell a different story. The company has never been stronger financially,
generating $29 million
in free cash flow last quarter alone while maintaining $775 million in cash reserves.
This move appears to be designed primarily to boost a stock price that, despite the recent surge, remains
73% below its IPO level
.
Weren’t

data.title: Apple announces American Manufacturing Program
data.author: Zenbit_UX
data.article_summary: 苹果公司宣布将美国投资承诺增加至6000亿美元，并推出“美国制造计划”（American Manufacturing Program, AMP）。该计划旨在将更多供应链和先进制造转移至美国，与包括Corning、Texas Instruments等在内的多家公司合作，推动关键零部件在美国生产。苹果计划未来四年在美国直接雇佣20,000人，主要集中在研发、硅工程、软件开发以及人工智能领域。此外，苹果还扩展了与Corning的合作，将在肯塔基州建立全球最大智能手机玻璃生产线，所有iPhone和Apple Watch将使用该地生产的玻璃。同时，苹果正与台积电在亚利桑那州合作生产芯片，目标在2025年生产超过190亿颗芯片，支持美国在半导体行业的领导地位。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[苹果公司对美国经济的投资承诺及其实际效果，以及Tim Cook向特朗普赠送黄金礼物的行为]

不同观点：
• **质疑投资承诺的真实性**  
  - 用户列举了苹果2017、2018和2021年的多次投资承诺（如3500亿、4300亿美元），但缺乏后续实际执行证据（如njovin、xnx）。  
  - 举例Foxconn和Intel的“空头工厂”案例（insane_dreamer），认为此类声明多为公关噱头。  

• **对制造业回流的争议**  
  - 部分用户认为苹果新增就业集中在研发而非制造（insane_dreamer），且组装环节仍依赖中国（fennecfoxy）。  
  - energy123支持芯片制造回流，但反对消费电子组装回流的低效性。  

• **Tim Cook赠送黄金礼物的批评**  
  - 被讽刺为“向特朗普进贡”（Buttons840），或视为讨好威权政府的软弱行为（Arubis、cfyohyuityun）。

PRESS RELEASE
August 6, 2025
Apple increases U.S. commitment to $600 billion, announces American Manufacturing Program
Apple supports more than 450,000 jobs with thousands of suppliers and partners across all 50 states — including significant expansions in Arizona, California, Iowa, Kentucky, Nevada, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, and Utah
Apple increased its U.S. investment commitment to $600 billion and announced the launch of its American Manufacturing Program.
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA
Apple today announced a new $100 billion commitment to America, a significant acceleration of its U.S. investment that now totals $600 billion over the next four years. Today’s announcement includes the ambitious new American Manufacturing Program (AMP), dedicated to bringing even more of Apple’s supply chain and advanced manufacturing to the U.S. Through AMP, Apple will increase its investment across America and incentivize global companies to manufacture even more critical components in the United States.
“Today, we’re proud to increase our investments across the United States to $600 billion over four years and launch our new American Manufacturing Program,” said Tim Cook, Apple’s CEO. “This includes new and expanded work with 10 companies across America. They produce components that are used in Apple products sold all over the world, and we’re grateful to the President for his support.”
Apple parts and components manufactured in the U.S. ship to customers around the world; in fact, roughly two-thirds of the components made in the U.S. are exported to customers outside the U.S.
Today, Apple partners with thousands of suppliers across all 50 states, supporting more than 450,000 supplier and partner jobs. In the next four years, Apple plans to directly hire 20,000 people in the U.S. — the vast majority focused on R&D, silicon engineering, software development, and AI and machine learning.
Apple
American Manufacturing Program
Apple is working with its suppliers to accelerate manufacturing in the U.S. through the new American Manufacturing Program. The first AMP partners include Corning, Coherent, GlobalWafers America (GWA), Applied Materials, Texas Instruments (TI), Samsung, GlobalFoundries, Amkor, and Broadcom. This builds on
Apple’s July commitment
to buy American-made rare earth magnets from MP Materials.
The American Manufacturing Program will help fund a
major expansion of Apple’s long-standing partnership with Corning
, bringing the world’s largest and most advanced smartphone glass production line to a factory in Harrodsburg, Kentucky. The expansion means that soon, every iPhone and Apple Watch sold around the world will be built with Kentucky-made cover glass. The two companies will also open a new Apple-Corning Innovation Center in Kentucky.
Apple has also entered into a new multiyear agreement with Coherent, a long-standing partner that produces the VCSEL lasers that enable multiple features — including Face ID — on iPhone and iPad devices shipped around the world. This work takes place at Coherent’s Sherman, Texas, facility.
In July, Apple also committed to buying American-made rare earth magnets developed by MP Materials — the only fully integrated rare earth producer in the United States — significantly expanding their flagship Independence facility in Fort Worth, Texas. These magnets will become part of Apple devices shipped around the world. The two companies will also establish a cutting-edge rare earth recycling line in Mountain Pass, California.
Through its new American Manufacturing Program, Apple is working with American suppliers like Corning to accelerate U.S. manufacturing.
Through its new American Manufacturing Program, Apple is working with American suppliers like Corning to accelerate U.S. manufacturing.
Apple Expands End-to-End American Silicon Supply Chain
With these new partnerships, Apple is leading the creation of an end-to-end silicon supply chain in the United States, with partners in every key aspect of silicon production.
This U.S. silicon supply chain is on track to produce more than 19 billion chips for Apple products in 2025. That includes TSMC in Arizona, which is producing tens of millions of chips for Apple using one of the most advanced process technologies in America. Apple is this factory’s first and largest customer.
“Apple engineers work closely with suppliers across the United States to create silicon chips that are on the leading edge of innovation,” said Sabih Khan, Apple’s chief operating officer. “We’re committed to supporting U.S. suppliers involved in every key stage of the chip-making process — from the earliest stages of research and development, to final fabrication and packaging. We want America to lead in this critical industry, and we’re expanding our efforts to grow a silicon manufacturing ecosystem that will benefit innovators across America.”

data.title: FDA approves eye drops that fix near vision without glasses
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: FDA批准了一种突破性的眼药水——VIZZ，用于改善老花眼（ presbyopia ）导致的近视力模糊，无需眼镜。这种由LENZ公司开发的药水含有阿西克利定（aceclidine），每天使用一次，可在不影响远视力的情况下，提供长达10小时的清晰近视力。与早期可能导致眉毛沉重或其他副作用的眼药水不同，VIZZ通过缩小瞳孔产生“针孔效应”来改善视力，且不显著刺激眼部聚焦肌肉。该批准基于多项临床试验数据，显示其安全有效，预计2025年第四季度广泛上市。这一创新为数百万受老花眼困扰的成年人提供了新的治疗选择。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新型眼药水VIZZ的功效、安全性、市场前景以及与现有产品的比较。

不同观点：
• [对审批流程的质疑] merek指出FDA批准基于药企提交的试验数据，而同行评审报告通常在监管批准后发布。他对为何数据在批准后发布表示困惑。
• [个人经历与选择] FabHK提到自己在考虑LASIK/SMILE手术时，医生推荐了“单视”方案，并询问其他人是否有相关经验。
• [市场表现分析] gnatman认为Vuity（已有类似产品）市场表现不佳，可能不是因为副作用，而是因为长期使用的性价比不高。
• [产品机制与副作用] modeless和leephillips讨论了产品通过缩小瞳孔增加景深，但也指出这会减少进入眼睛的光线，可能影响视觉亮度。
• [价格与订阅模式] Mistletoe关注产品的成本，担心从一次性购买眼镜转向长期订阅眼药水。rf15也表达了对订阅模式的担忧。
• [产品适用性与剂量] pazimzadeh关心轻度老花眼的使用剂量以及过量使用的风险。amelius则提到瞳孔缩小在美观上的影响。
• [对监管机构的信任] jmclnx对FDA由于削减开支表示不信任，因此会等待多年后再考虑使用该产品。

补充讨论：
• [科幻联想] Drunk_Engineer幽默地将该产品与《星际迷航》中的Retinox5联系起来，引发了一些对未来科技的联想。
• [照明替代方案] wat10000提出是否可以通过增加照明达到类似效果，而不是依赖瞳孔缩小。

争议焦点：
• 产品发布前后的数据透明度以及为何同行评审报告在批准后发布。
• 市场对类似产品接受度低的原因是副作用还是性价比问题。
• 瞳孔缩小带来的视觉亮度降低和美观问题是否值得接受。
• 从一次性购买眼镜转向订阅眼药水的经济和实际使用影响。

The first aceclidine-based eye drop to improve near vision in adults with presbyopia, which affects more than 100 million adults in the US alone, has been approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and will be available within three months.
Known as VIZZ, from pharmaceutical company LENZ, the drops are an aceclidine ophthalmic solution that effectively treats
presbyopia
in adults. The once-daily drops offer relief from blurry near. vision for up to 10 hours.
"The FDA approval of VIZZ is a defining moment for LENZ and represents a transformative improvement in the available treatment options for the 128 million adults living with blurry near vision in the United States," said Eef Schimmelpennink, President and Chief Executive Officer of LENZ Therapeutics. "This significant milestone is the result of tremendous commitment and collaboration by the LENZ team and our partners, the dedication of our clinical investigators, and the contributions of hundreds of participants in our clinical trials."
VIZZ works by gently shrinking the pupil of the eye, using aceclidine. This creates a “pinhole effect” – like narrowing a camera lens — which helps bring nearby objects into sharper focus. Unlike older eye drops, this one does not significantly affect the eye’s focusing muscles, so it doesn’t blur your distance vision or cause that “zoomed-in” effect (aka a myopic shift).
Ultimately, the drops offer improved reading vision for up to 10 hours, without the need for glasses and, importantly, without the side effects of older treatments.
In 2021, the very first drops to treat this condition were launched
to much acclaim, but there's a reason VIZZ drops are considered first-in-class. Vuity (pilocarpine hydrochloride 1.25%) is a dual-action eye drop that can improve near vision but may cause side effects like brow heaviness or rare vitreoretinal issues due to the ciliary muscle activation. Aceclidine, a pupil-selective miotic, works without significantly stimulating the focusing (ciliary) muscle, creating a pinhole effect – which improves near vision without adverse outcomes seen in Vuity.
"This FDA approval represents a disruptive paradigm shift in treatment options for millions of people who are frustrated and struggling with the inevitable age-related loss of their near vision," said VIZZ clinical investigator Marc Bloomenstein, from Schwartz Laser Eye Care Center in Scottsdale, Arizona. "I believe this will be a welcome solution for both optometrists and ophthalmologists who will now be able to offer a highly effective and sought-after presbyopia treatment that could immediately become the standard of care, with a product profile that will meet our patients’ needs."
The FDA approval comes on the back of three randomized, double-masked, controlled Phase II studies featuring hundreds of participants. VIZZ was well-tolerated with no serious adverse events observed in the 30,000-plus treatment days across all three trials.
Presbyopia is, unfortunately, an inevitable condition associated with aging. Almost everyone over the age of 45 experiences this near-sight vision loss, which gradually gets worse and usually requires correction with glasses or contact lenses. While presbyopia is a gradual condition, it can progress quickly and unexpectedly, making formerly simple tasks of day-to-day tasks like reading instructions or food labels more difficult.
The therapeutics company said VIZZ is expected to be broadly available in the fourth quarter of 2025, making it the first and only FDA-approved aceclidine-based eye drop for presbyopia treatment.
"This is uniquely engineered, highly-differentiated and designed to deliver quick onset and lasting benefit for the vast majority of presbyopes," said Schimmelpennink. "As we have shown, this is not only best-in-class, but frankly, the only in a class of pupil selective ciliary-sparing myotics."
The FDA approval comes based on trial data submitted by the pharmaceutical company, so it's worth noting that published peer-reviewed reports are yet to be published. Peer-reviewed publications often follow regulatory approvals, not precede them, which is common in the field of ophthalmology and dermatology.
However, the FDA data and guidance can be found
published here

data.author: samsullivan
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了车辆识别号码（VIN）的标准及其在汽车行业中的重要性。1979年，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）为统一车辆识别标准，推出了17位字符的VIN系统。该系统不仅是一个唯一标识符，还包含了车辆的详细信息，并具有数学验证功能。每辆车在上市前，制造商必须提交详细的“565文件”，包括技术规格、安全系统描述、VIN解码模式等。VIN分为三个部分：世界制造商识别码（WMI）、车辆描述部分（VDS）和车辆识别部分（VIS）。WMI标识地理区域和制造商，VDS由制造商自定义编码车辆属性，VIS包含生产年份和序列号等信息。美国是唯一公开这些数据的国家，使其成为全球VIN解码的标准。

44819668.article_content:
The 17-character code that runs the automotive world
In 1979, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration faced a problem: how do you track 100+ million vehicles across 50 states when every manufacturer uses different serial number schemes? Their solution became one of the most successful information architecture projects in history - the Vehicle Identification Number standard.
What emerged wasn't just a unique identifier. It was a compressed database record, a mathematical validation system, and a regulatory framework that would process 17 million new vehicles annually while maintaining backward compatibility for decades.
This is how that system actually works.
The 565 submittal system: How vehicles enter the database
Before any vehicle can legally be sold in the United States, its manufacturer must submit a "565 submittal" to NHTSA. This isn't marketing fluff - it's a comprehensive technical document that defines every measurable aspect of the vehicle.
Each 565 submittal contains:
Complete technical specifications (engine, transmission, dimensions, weights)
Safety system descriptions (airbags, ABS, stability control)
VIN decoding patterns for that specific model/year combination
Manufacturing plant assignments
Expected production volumes
Here is a sample 565 submittal for the 2025 Tesla Lineup
NHTSA reviews these submissions and assigns VIN patterns. This is why a 2024 Honda Civic uses different VDS codes than a 2023 - each model year requires new 565 submittals and gets new VIN patterns.
The United States is unique in making this data public. European WVTA (Whole Vehicle Type Approval) data remains proprietary. Japan's type approval system is fragmented across prefectures. China's vehicle database is state-controlled.
Only the NHTSA publishes comprehensive vehicle technical data for free, making American automotive data the global standard for VIN decoding.
VIN structure: 17 characters of compressed information
The VIN standard divides the 17-character identifier into three functional sections:
World Manufacturer Identifier (WMI): Positions 1-3
The WMI system is administered by the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) and uses a hierarchical allocation:
Position 1 - Geographic Region:
1-5: North America
6-7: Oceania
8-9: South America
A-H: Africa
J-R: Asia
S-Z: Europe
Position 2 - Country Code:
Within North America (1-5):
1,4,5: United States
2: Canada
3: Mexico
Position 3 - Manufacturer:
Assigned sequentially within each country. Tesla received "J" in the US 5Y_ block.
The WMI assignment is permanent. When Tesla was assigned "5YJ", they cannot change it without regulatory approval. This stability is crucial for recall systems and historical tracking.
Vehicle Descriptor Section (VDS): Positions 4-9
The VDS is where manufacturers encode vehicle-specific attributes. Unlike the standardized WMI, each manufacturer submits their own VDS schema to NHTSA as part of their 565 submittal.

data.title: We replaced passwords with something worse
data.author: max__dev
data.article_summary: 文章指出，许多服务采用了一种不安全的登录方式：用户输入邮箱或电话号码，网站发送六位验证码进行登录。这种方法存在严重安全漏洞，攻击者可以向合法服务发送用户邮箱，获取六位验证码，进而欺骗用户输入码进行盗号。由于密码管理器无法防御此类钓鱼攻击，该方法已被用于成功盗取微软Minecraft账户。文章呼吁停止使用这种不安全的登录方式。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：基于电子邮件一次性验证码的登录流程及其替代方案的优缺点

不同观点：
• DecoPerson认为，基于电子邮件的一次性验证码登录流程极易受到钓鱼攻击，用户容易被误导在恶意网站上输入验证码，从而导致账户被盗。DecoPerson推荐使用Passkey，认为其更安全且逐渐得到密码管理器的良好支持。
• StillBored批评了一些服务未经用户同意就更改密码和二次认证方式，导致用户在无法访问手机时被锁定在外。同时，StillBored指出通过短信或电子邮件发送的二次验证方式安全性不足。
• iEchoic描述了其Microsoft账户频繁收到密码重置请求的经历，指出攻击者可以通过大量猜测来窃取账户，但服务提供商并未将其视为安全漏洞。
• Angostura表示难以理解某些描述复杂的登录流程，特别是涉及将验证码输入到不可信界面的情况。
• rsanheim支持使用现代密码管理器，认为其比电子邮件验证码更安全、方便，且设置并不复杂，类似于管理物理钥匙。
• wkat4242认为电子邮件验证码流程不便捷，需要等待和手动输入，推荐使用更简单和安全的Passkey。
• FabHK指出，某些浏览器会自动填充用户名和密码，但对于仅提供电子邮件字段的网站则需手动填写，特别是使用多个邮箱的用户会更麻烦。
• clement_b批评某些产品强制使用验证码登录，而不允许用户使用长密码或社交登录方式。
• allears62抱怨Spotify的登录体验不佳，尤其是频繁生成和发送六位验证码到共享邮箱，既浪费资源又存在安全风险。
• ameliaquining总结了两点抱怨：验证码易被钓鱼和仅需入侵邮箱即可劫持账户。同时，提出通过使用类似Slack的登录链接代替验证码、推广Passkey等解决方案。

补充讨论：
• pandorobo批评文章描述不清晰，未能提供更好的多因素认证（MFA）推荐。
• kazinator澄清文章批评的是需要用户手动输入验证码的流程，因其易受中间人攻击，而非基于电子邮件的URL登录方式。
• gregorvand认为服务提供商偏爱电子邮件验证码登录是因为能将风险和责任转嫁给Google/Gmail等邮箱服务提供商。

争议焦点：
• 电子邮件一次性验证码登录流程的安全性与便捷性之间的平衡。
• 使用Passkey等新兴认证方式的推广难度与实际效果。
• 服务提供商在更改认证方式时未充分考虑用户体验和安全性。

44819917.article_content:
We replaced passwords with something worse
​
Too many services have been using the following login method:
Enter an email address or phone number
The website will send a 6-digit code
Use the 6-digit code to log in
Please stop.
This is terrible for account security:
An attacker can simply send your email address to a legitimate service, and prompt for a 6-digit code. You can't know for sure if the code is supposed to be entered in the right place. Password managers (a usual defense against phishing) can't help you either.
In fact, this attack method has been successfully used in the wild: Microsoft's login for Minecraft accounts use this login method, and
many
accounts
have
been
stolen
already.

• rsanheim支持使用现代密码管理器，认为其比电子邮件验证码更安全、方便，且设置并不复杂，类似于管理物理钥匙。
• wkat4242认为电子邮件验证码流程不便捷，需要等待和手动输入，推荐使用更简单和安全的Passkey。
• FabHK指出，某些浏览器会自动填充用户名和密码，但对于仅提供电子邮件字段的网站则需手动填写，特别是使用多个邮箱的用户会更麻烦。
• clement_b批评某些产品强制使用验证码登录，而不允许用户使用长密码或社交登录方式。
• allears62抱怨Spotify的登录体验不佳，尤其是频繁生成和发送六位验证码到共享邮箱，既浪费资源又存在安全风险。
• ameliaquining总结了两点抱怨：验证码易被钓鱼和仅需入侵邮箱即可劫持账户。同时，提出通过使用类似Slack的登录链接代替验证码、推广Passkey等解决方案。

补充讨论：
• pandorobo批评文章描述不清晰，未能提供更好的多因素认证（MFA）推荐。
• kazinator澄清文章批评的是需要用户手动输入验证码的流程，因其易受中间人攻击，而非基于电子邮件的URL登录方式。
• gregorvand认为服务提供商偏爱电子邮件验证码登录是因为能将风险和责任转嫁给Google/Gmail等邮箱服务提供商。

争议焦点：
• 电子邮件一次性验证码登录流程的安全性与便捷性之间的平衡。
• 使用Passkey等新兴认证方式的推广难度与实际效果。
• 服务提供商在更改认证方式时未充分考虑用户体验和安全性。

data.title: Grok's 'Spicy' Mode Makes NSFW Celebrity Deepfakes of Women (But Not Men)
data.author: ryan_j_naughton
data.article_summary: Elon Musk's xAI公司推出了Grok Imagine应用，允许iOS用户生成图片和视频，订阅SuperGrok和Premium+ X的用户还可以使用“Spicy”模式创建不适宜工作场所观看的内容。该模式可轻松生成裸体视频，如泰勒·斯威夫特等名人，甚至历史人物如玛莎·华盛顿。然而，该工具生成的女性视频往往更具挑逗性，而男性视频则多为简单的脱衬衫，没有更多露骨内容。尽管有一些内容审核，但仍存在生成名人虚假色情内容的风险。主流AI生成器通常设有防护机制，而Grok的这一功能引发了对隐私和道德的担忧。目前，xAI尚未回应相关质询。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科技公司是否应该为用户提供硬件维修权（Right to Repair）

不同观点：
• **支持Right to Repair的观点：**
  - 用户应该有权自行修理或选择第三方维修服务，而不是只能依赖制造商。
  - 制造商通过限制维修手段来推动产品淘汰，缩短了产品生命周期。
  - 提供维修权可以减少电子废物，有利于环境保护。
  - 论据例子：汽车行业有成熟的第三方维修市场，科技行业应效仿。

• **反对Right to Repair的观点：**
  - 制造商担心泄露专有技术或设计，可能导致山寨产品泛滥。
  - 开放维修权可能带来安全隐患，尤其是涉及电池和复杂电子元件时。
  - 维修过程中可能出现质量问题，影响品牌声誉和用户体验。
  - 论据例子：未经培训的个人或第三方维修可能无法达到原厂维修标准。

• **中立或条件支持观点：**
  - 支持Right to Repair，但认为需要设定标准和认证机制，以确保维修质量。
  - 建议制造商提供详细的维修手册和原厂零件，同时开放第三方维修市场。
  - 强调平衡用户权益与制造商利益的重要性，建议通过立法找到中间 ground。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点：**
  - 维修权的法律和政策框架应如何设计，以平衡用户和制造商的权益。
  - 用户自行维修或选择第三方维修是否会导致更多的安全事故和质量问题。
  - 制造商是否应公开专有技术和设计，以支持维修权的落实。

• **其他讨论点：**
  - 消费者对电子产品维修的实际需求和意愿，是否足以推动市场变革。
  - 欧洲等地区在Right to Repair方面的立法进展，对全球市场的潜在影响。
  - 电子废物问题的严重性及Right to Repair在其中的角色和贡献。

通过这些观点的碰撞，可以看出Right to Repair的讨论不仅仅是技术问题，更涉及法律、环境、经济等多方面因素。

This week, Elon Musk officially launched Grok Imagine, xAIâs image and video generator for iOS, for people who subscribe to SuperGrok and Premium+ X. The app allows users to create NSFW content with its “Spicy” mode, and
The Verge
reported on Tuesday that users are able to create topless videos of Taylor Swift easilyâwithout even asking for it. But it’s not just Swift who should be concerned about Musk’s new AI-generated softcore porn tool.
Gizmodo created about two dozen videos of politicians, celebrities, and tech figures using the Grok Spicy mode, though some were blurred out or came back with a message reading “video moderated.” When Grok did make scandalous images, it would only make the ones depicting women truly not-safe-for-work. Videos of men were the kind of thing that wouldn’t really raise many eyebrows.
X has been swamped over the past two days with AI-generated images of naked women and tips on how to achieve the most nudity. But users, who’ve created tens of millions of Grok Imagine images
according to Musk
, don’t even need to go to some great effort to get deepfakes of naked celebrities. Gizmodo didn’t explicitly ask for nudity in the examples we cite in this article, but we still got plenty of it. All we did was click on the Spicy button, which is one of four options, along with Custom, Fun, and Normal.
Gizmodo tested Grok Imagine by generating videos of not just Taylor Swift, but other prominent women like Melania Trump and historical figures like Martha Washington. Melania Trump has been a vocal supporter of the Take It Down Act, which
makes it illegal
to publish non-consensual “intimate imagery,” including deepfakes.
Grok also created a not-safe-for-work video of the late feminist writer Valerie Solanas, author of 1967’s
S.C.U.M Manifesto
. Almost all of the videos depicted the women that we tested as shedding clothes to make them naked from the waist up, though the video of Solanas was unique in that it did show her completely naked.
What happens when you try to generate Spicy videos of men? The AI will have the male figure take off his shirt, but there’s nothing more scandalous than that. When Gizmodo figured out that it would only remove a man’s shirt, we prompted the AI to create a shirtless image of Elon Musk and see what it might do with that. The result was the extremely ridiculous (and safe-for-work) video you
see below
.
Attempts to make videos of Mark Zuckerberg, Jeff Bezos, Joaquin Phoenix, and Charlie Chaplin, as well as Presidents Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and George Washington, ran into the same limitation. The AI-generated videos will have the men take their shirts off most of the time, but there’s nothing beyond that. And if there is anything more, it’s usually so cringe that we’d worry about users dying from secondhand embarrassment. Making a Spicy video of Errol Musk, Elon’s father, produced the same thing. He just took off his shirt.
When we made a generic man to see if Spicy mode would be more loose with its sexual content since it wasn’t a known public figure, it still just made a bizarre, awkward video of a man tugging at his pants. The pants, it should be noted, seem to be a combination of shorts for one leg and long jeans for the other before transforming into just shorts. The audio for each video was also auto-generated without any further instruction.
Trying the same thing with a generic woman rendered much more revealing images of a woman in a swimsuit who pulls down the top to reveal her naked breasts.
Most mainstream AI video generators, like OpenAIâs Sora and Googleâs Veo, have guardrails to protect against the creation of things like revenge porn and images of celebrities. And it seems like xAI does in some ways, at least for men. But most people would probably object to their image being used to create an AI avatar in various states of undress. Gizmodo reached out to Musk through xAI to ask about safeguards and whether it’s acceptable for users to create topless videos of celebrities. We haven’t heard back.
One of the most striking things about Grok’s AI image generator is that it’s often terrible at making convincing celebrity fakes. For example, the images below were generated when asking for Vice President JD Vance and actress Sydney Sweeney. And unless we completely forgot how those two people look, it’s not even close. That could turn out to be Musk’s saving grace, given the fact that a tool like this is bound to attract lawsuits.
Phone screenshots of images created by SuperGrok that are supposed to depict Sydney Sweeney and JD Vance. Screenshots: xAI

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于网页存档工具的使用体验和效果评价

不同观点：
• **观点一：网页存档工具效果不佳**  
  └ 论据和例子：  
    - ur-whale 认为存档工具（如 archive.today）在保存网页时，常常出现样式丢失、图片无法显示等问题，导致保存后的页面难以阅读和使用。  
    - 举例说明某些包含复杂布局或动态内容的网页，存档后经常出现排版混乱。  
    - 认为存档工具对现代网页技术（如JavaScript、CSS等）的处理能力不足。

• **观点二：网页存档工具在不断改进，可以接受一定瑕疵**  
  └ 论据和例子：  
    - 一些用户认为，虽然存档工具在保存网页时确实存在样式丢失等问题，但这是技术限制所致，工具本身在不断改进。  
    - 强调存档工具的主要目的是保存网页内容的核心信息，而非完美复现所有视觉效果。  
    - 举例说明某些存档工具已经能够较好地保存文本和基本结构，这在许多情况下已经足够。

• **观点三：不同存档工具之间的效果差异较大**  
  └ 论据和例子：  
    - 有用户指出，不同的网页存档工具效果不同，例如 archive.today 和 Wayback Machine 在处理相同网页时，结果可能有所不同。  
    - 建议用户根据具体需求选择合适的存档工具，有些工具可能在保存特定类型网页时表现更好。  
    - 提到某些工具提供了手动调整和重新抓取的功能，可以在一定程度上改善存档效果。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点：存档工具的实用性与技术限制之间的矛盾**  
  └ 争议的焦点在于用户对网页存档工具的期望与其实际能力之间的差距。部分用户期望存档工具能够完美复现网页的所有细节，而另一些用户则认为保存核心信息已经达到目的，接受一定程度的瑕疵。

• **建议与改进**  
  └ 一些用户建议存档工具开发者应加强对现代网页技术的支持，提高保存网页的完整性和准确性。同时，也有用户提出可以开发浏览器插件或工具，帮助用户手动调整和优化存档效果。

通过分析评论，可以看出用户对网页存档工具的评价存在明显分歧，主要集中在工具的效果、技术限制以及实际应用中的可接受程度。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：玩家对Whittle游戏的玩法、用户体验（UX）、用户界面（UI）及技术实现的反馈和建议

不同观点：
• jsnell认为游戏有两个目标（消除所有字母和找到所有单词）让人困惑，特别是颜色提示让玩家倾向于完成所有单词，但这个过程显得乏味。此外，桌面版的UI缺乏悬停效果，点击字母时没有反馈，建议至少改变鼠标指针样式。
• stephenlf及其妻子非常喜欢这个游戏，认为其具有挑战性，并能一次性解决多个谜题。
• jodrellblank分享了一个用SWI Prolog实现的解谜方案，展示了如何通过递归和回溯搜索所有可能的游戏状态，并提供了代码示例和解释。
• unnamed76ri建议添加一个“放弃”按钮，让玩家可以锁定当天的结果并结束游戏。
• duncancarroll指出游戏结束时缺乏“胜利”状态或提示，容易让玩家感到困惑，建议增加新的单词对或提示让玩家知道明天可以再来。
• jangerhofer提醒玩家空格也是可以“削减”的字符。
• onion92提到他们有一个类似的想法，并分享了相关链接。
• porjo建议允许移动字母或空格到新的位置，作为一种“生命线”机制，每局游戏允许一到两次移动。
• c22提到这个游戏与他们曾经玩过的一种单词游戏相反，描述了那种游戏的玩法规则。
• pimlottc反馈初始游戏状态不明确，字母可以直接点击的提示不明显，底部未标记的标签让人困惑，点击右侧标签时容易误操作，建议增加标签和提示。
• zimpenfish提出一个小的建议，认为“back to archive”应该返回到玩家所在的存档页面，而不是“today”页面。
• teach质疑是否总能将字母减少到一个，特别是对某些日期的谜题感到挑战。
• davidsojevic提到最新的更新可能导致游戏无法开始，出现了技术错误。
• yobananaboy认为应该在只剩一个字母时提示胜利状态，而不是让玩家自行判断。
• jessecoleman提到这个游戏让他想起了自己开发的单词游戏，但实际玩法不同，并赞赏了Whittle的UX设计。

补充讨论：

data.title: Ex-Google exec: The idea that AI will create new jobs is '100% crap'
data.author: hibern8
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了人工智能（AI）对就业市场的深远影响。前Google X高管Mo Gawdat警告，AI可能会取代各类工作，包括高管、视频编辑和播客制作人，甚至医生和教师。他指出，AI将超越人类能力，最终可能连CEO都能取代。不过，像Mark Cuban和Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang等其他领袖认为，学习AI技能和强化软技能能让人在职场中更具竞争力。尽管41%的雇主计划因AI缩减员工规模，但77%计划通过技能提升让现有员工与AI更好地合作。Gawdat还提到，AI可能带来社会变革，如普遍基本收入（UBI），但也需警惕AI的伦理使用和监管。总的来说，AI正在彻底改变生活和工作方式，且已成为现实。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：技术对就业市场的影响

不同观点：
• **Parineum的观点**：技术的主要作用是提高工作效率，减少对人工劳动的需求，从而降低产品成本。这使得消费者有更多的可支配收入去消费其他商品或服务，进而催生出新的市场和就业机会。简言之，技术虽然减少了一些岗位，但通过创造新需求，间接创造了新的就业机会。

• **David927的观点**：技术创新和发展的美好承诺就是减少工作岗位。这一观点暗示技术的主要贡献是自动化和替代人工，而不是创造新的就业机会。该立场更侧重于技术对传统岗位的替代效应，而不是新岗位的创造。

• **Flatcircle的观点**：技术使得某些技能（如操作电脑）的价值下降。过去某些高薪工作（如与计算机相关的职位）因技术进步和普及，薪酬水平可能降低，因为这些技能变得更容易获得或由机器替代。这里强调的是技术进步对工资水平的负面影响。

补充讨论：
• **关于技术对就业市场的双重影响**：Parineum和David927的观点形成了对比，前者认为技术减少人工需求但通过增加消费创造新岗位，而后者则更关注技术减少岗位的直接影响。Flatcircle补充了技术对工资水平的潜在影响，提出了技术进步可能导致某些工作薪酬下降的观点。

• **争议焦点**：技术究竟是创造了更多新的就业机会，还是仅仅减少了现有岗位。Parineum强调新市场的出现，而David927和Flatcircle则关注技术对岗位和薪酬的负面影响。这反映了对技术进步带来的经济效应的不同理解和预期。

tech will displace humans completely
Mo Gawdat speaks at BoF VOICES 2022 at Soho Farmhouse on November 29, 2022 in Chipping Norton, England.
Kate Green | Getty Images Entertainment | Getty Images
Mo Gawdat, former chief business officer at Google X, the company's innovation lab, says AI is likely coming for your role — whether you're in the C-suite or an entry-level worker.
The idea that artificial intelligence will create jobs is "100% crap," Gawdat said Monday on the "Diary of a CEO"
podcast
, using his own AI startup, Emma.love, as an example. He and two other software experts built the app with the help of AI, a project that would have required "350 developers in the past," he said.
Gawdat has worked in tech for over 30 years. He was in the C-suite at Google X for almost five years tackling major problems facing humanity, like energy, climate change and internet access.
Even the jobs you may think require humans will be eliminated, including video editors, podcasters and executives, said Gawdat. Bill Gates has predicted that
doctors and teachers
will also be replaced in the coming years.
Those who have the most promising outlook are professionals who are the best at their jobs, said Gawdat, author of "
Scary Smart: The Future of Artificial Intelligence and How You Can Save Our World
." But even they won't be safe forever.
Artificial general intelligence is "going to be better than humans at everything, including being a CEO," said Gawdat. "There will be a time where most incompetent CEOs will be replaced."
A competitive edge in the workforce
Other leaders say AI isn't all doom and gloom. Billionaires
Mark Cuban
and
Jensen Huang
, for example, say learning AI skills — in addition to strengthening soft skills — will make you highly desirable in the workplace and give you a competitive edge. After all, somebody has to program, develop and train the chatbots, and teach others to do the same.
Both Cuban, who has a free AI boot camp for kids, and Huang, whose company develops the chips and software powering many of today's generative systems, use artificial intelligence on a daily basis for tasks like writing
first drafts
, sending emails and getting
medical advice
.
Though 41% of employers globally plan to downsize their workforce due to AI (48% in the U.S.), 77% of employers are planning to upskill their current workforce to better work alongside AI, according to The World Economic Forum's 2025 Future of Jobs
report
. Moreover, 47% are looking at transitioning employees from declining roles into other roles in the organization.
Put simply, companies aren't going on a firing spree to replace human workers with robots right now.
An AI-powered future may not be all bad
Though Gawdat says the job market will suffer greatly due to AI, this economic shift may help spark necessary change to our
outlook on work
, giving people more time to spend with family, cultivate new hobbies, pursue philanthropy and find an identity outside of a job title.
"We were never made to wake up every morning and just occupy 20 hours of our day with work. We're not made for that," he said. "We defined our purpose as work. That's a capitalist lie."
An AI-powered society would require some kind of universal basic income (UBI), said Gawdat, a social welfare policy that ensures all citizens of a community regularly receive a payment from the government without work requirements.
The other caveat to this "utopia" is the potentially dangerous consequences of the "hunger for power, greed and ego" as AI bots report to "stupid leaders," said Gawdat, calling for ethical use and regulations around artificial intelligence.
No matter the impact of artificial intelligence, or the approaches different leaders take, one thing remains undisputable: AI is no longer a curiosity, or a plot line in a sci-fi film. It's revolutionizing the way people live and work. And it's here to stay.
"This is real," Gawdat said. "This is not science fiction."

data.title: AI is propping up the US economy
data.author: mempko
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了AI泡沫对美国经济的推动作用，以及AI领域近期的重要动态。微软在AI驱动下成为继Nvidia后第二家市值达4万亿美元的公司，显示出AI热潮对科技巨头市值的巨大影响。AI相关投资已超过互联网泡沫时期的电信和网络基础设施支出，成为支撑美国经济的“私营部门刺激计划”。此外，文章提到美国教授正组织抵制AI进入高等教育，以及AI模型在《Vogue》杂志引发的争议和Builder.AI公司的崩溃。最后，作者呼吁支持其独立 journalism 工作，以继续深入报道AI相关动态。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI投资热潮的规模、影响及其潜在泡沫

不同观点：
• jackcosgrove：认为当前的AI投资热潮虽然规模巨大，但与19世纪的铁路投资热潮相比仍有差距。他引用数据指出，铁路投资曾达到美国GDP的20%，而当前AI资本支出仅为2%。因此，AI投资仍有很大的增长空间。
• digitcatphd：对AI投资热潮持怀疑态度，将其与加密货币泡沫相比较，并警告称一旦泡沫破裂，影响将更严重。他还将AI投资热潮比作核军备竞赛，质疑其最终的经济效益，并担心当前的投资基于恐惧错失机会（FOMO）而非实际回报。
• antman：认为AI带来的经济增长无法与过去的经济扩张相比，因为AI可能导致极端的不平等，且没有有效的经济模型或经验来管理这种不平等。他还担心AI会导致社会控制结构的极端化。
• 0cf8612b2e1e：强调AI资本支出对美国经济的巨大贡献，指出其对经济增长的贡献甚至超过了消费支出，并将AI投资视为一种私营部门的刺激措施。
• Animats：认为当前的AI投资热潮如果不能实现显著的技术突破（如达到奇点），可能会导致大规模的经济崩溃，类似于过去的技术泡沫。
• rglover：担心AI投资热潮破裂可能引发严重的经济危机，尤其是考虑到当前的高债务水平和政治环境，可能导致比互联网泡沫破裂更严重的经济衰退。
• throwmeaway222：指出微软和Azure在AI领域的领先地位，并提到几乎所有合作公司都在使用其服务，但原因不明。
• nowittyusername：认为Nvidia在支撑科技行业，因为它是大多数公司GPU的主要供应商，如果Nvidia出现问题，可能会对整个行业和美国经济造成严重影响。
• jus3sixty：认为AI投资热潮与19世纪铁路投资热潮的比较在规模上成立，但在实际经济价值创造上不同，因为铁路投资创造了实际的基础设施和长期经济价值，而AI投资更多是短期资产密集型设施。
• throw0101d：引用其他文章讨论AI资本支出对经济统计数据的影响，指出AI数据中心的频繁硬件更换需求。
• highfrequency：反驳认为AI数据中心的短期寿命和频繁硬件更换实际上是在利用摩尔定律和学习曲线，知识的积累和效率的提高将带来长期经济价值。
• mrbluecoat：指出AI话题在媒体和网络上的高曝光率，认为AI也在支撑Hacker News的流量。
• GianFabien：从股市投资角度分析，认为AI投资热潮中的股票价格基于未来现金流或转售价值，如果泡沫破裂，股价将重置为基于实际股息的多倍数。
• jaredcwhite：表达对AI泡沫破裂可能带来的社会影响的恐惧，担心个人和社会都将受到严重影响。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于AI投资热潮是否会像过去的技术泡沫一样破裂，以及其对经济的实际影响。
• 讨论中多次提到历史上的经济泡沫和技术热潮，如互联网泡沫和铁路投资热潮，以类比当前的AI投资。
• 另一个重要讨论点是AI投资对社会不平等的影响，以及是否存在有效的经济模型来管理这种不平等。
• 技术进步和硬件更新带来的长期经济价值也是讨论的重要内容。
• 对Nvidia等关键供应商的依赖及其潜在风险也被提及，强调了供应链的脆弱性。

The AI boom reaches new heights
Last week, Microsoft became the second company, after Nvidia, to reach a $4 trillion valuation.
CNN
reports
:
Microsoft’s shares ﻿(
MSFT
) jumped nearly 4.5% after the market opened on Thursday, pushing its intraday valuation to $4.01 trillion. The company’s shares have risen roughly 28% since the start of this year.
The milestone comes just a year and a half after Microsoft reached a
$3 trillion valuation
. The company first cracked the
$1 trillion mark
in April 2019. It follows Nvidia into the $4 trillion valuation club, which hit the mark earlier this month.
There are so many wild and noteworthy things about this milestone that it’s hard to know when to start.
First, let’s take a second to note the sheer insanity of these numbers. The first company to hit a $1 trillion valuation in the modern era was Apple, in 2018. Now, just seven years later, there are
nine
$1 trillion+ tech companies, and Google, Amazon, and Meta are soaring past $2 trillion, and now Apple is well past $3 trillion. Much of this expansion of value has occurred in just the last two years, on the back of the AI boom. Nvidia tripled its valuation, becoming the first-ever $4 trillion company in the process, in less than
one year
.
Second, note the
source
of Microsoft’s new investor enthusiasm: Like Nvidia, MS seems to be primarily benefitting from the AI boom by selling shovels during the gold rush. While Nvidia cornered the market on chips needed to run AI’s resource-intensive computation, Microsoft is winning by selling cloud compute in bulk. (Notably its biggest client is OpenAI, which is part of a byzantine deal between the two companies, but more on that in a second.) Microsoft’s largest revenue source is now Azure, its cloud compute business. Azure used to be a distant second, behind industry leader Amazon Web Services, but better-than-expected sales there last quarter have driven Microsoft to its new peak.
Third, Microsoft and Nvidia are benefitting from bona fide historic levels of investment. Chris Mims sites the analysis of investor and programmer
Paul Kedrosky
in his most recent column in
the Wall Street Journal
:

data.title: SQLite offline sync for Android quick start
data.author: marcobambini
data.article_summary: SQLite Sync 是一个开源项目，旨在实现SQLite数据库的同步功能。项目提供了基础的框架和工具，帮助开发者在不同设备或服务之间同步SQLite数据库数据。目前该项目有1个分支，并获得了13个星标。要参与或关注该项目，用户需要登录平台。项目地址可在GitHub上找到，便于开发者 fork 或 star。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：SQLiteCloud的技术实现、开源性与许可问题、以及相关替代技术

不同观点：
• **Baobun的观点**：关注SQLiteCloud的网络同步功能与闭源SaaS（https://sqlitecloud.io）的紧密集成。Baobun认为，如果服务器端的同步API能够被文档化和版本化，将有助于避免供应商锁定问题，并允许独立的自托管后端实现。

• **Mjadobson的观点**：提到一个类似项目cr-sqlite（https://github.com/vlcn-io/cr-sqlite），并询问它与当前项目的关联性。他还指出crsqlite项目已不再维护，表示可能会考虑迁移到新项目。

• **Anty的观点**：对项目表示兴趣并提出两个技术问题：1) 是否支持外键约束（如ON DELETE和ON UPDATE）以及UNIQUE约束；2) 如何实现行级隐私，是依靠服务器逻辑不同步“禁止”行，还是通过加密实现。

• **Marcobambini的观点**：解释选择Elastic License 2的原因，主要是为了保护其技术投资，尤其是跨平台网络层的开发。该许可还可以防止其工作被大型科技公司商业利用和分叉。

• **Woadwarrior01的观点**：最初质疑项目名称可能侵犯SQLite作者的商标权，编辑后建议在README中明确说明名称的合法性以消除疑虑。

• **Xiphias2的观点**：认为项目看起来不错，但指出它并不是开源的。

• **0xferruccio的观点**：对项目的发布表示祝贺，持积极态度。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：项目的开源性与许可模式成为讨论的争议点。一方面，Baobun和Xiphias2对项目的闭源性质表示关注，另一方面，Marcobambini则强调了选择特定许可模式的必要性以保护其技术投资。

• **技术替代与迁移**：Mjadobson提到cr-sqlite项目，引发了对类似技术的比较和潜在迁移的讨论。

• **法律与商标问题**：Woadwarrior01提出的商标问题也值得注意，尽管在评论中已得到澄清，但仍建议在文档中明确说明以避免误解。
